CSC BLINDER X2 - pivots and axes (metres, as drawn in Minecraft = model x 2.20; Minecraft / glTF frame: Y up, front -Z)
base:  origin = bottom centre of the base (standing fixture); hung under a truss the whole fixture is turned 180 degrees about Z
head:  tilt pivot (0.0000, 0.3410, 0.0000) (in the base frame), tilt = rotation about +X, 0 degrees in total, positive raises the beam; head OBJ vertices are relative to this pivot
beam:  origin (0.0000, 0.0000, -0.1386) (head frame), axis (0.0000, 0.0000, -1.0000), lens radius 0.4268, zoom 90-90 degrees
